
log "REPORT"
echo "Domain:         example.com"
echo "PTR at your provider: 203.0.113.10 -> relay.example.com (critical for deliverability)."
echo "Backup passphrase (keep it — encrypted backups need it): $(cat /etc/gryonixnexus/autobackup.pass 2>/dev/null)"
echo
echo "Service status:"
for s in nftables docker caddy; do
  printf '  %-14s %s\n' "$s" "$(systemctl is-active "$s" || true)"
done
echo
echo "Remember the DNS records from dns-records.txt — without them Caddy cannot issue certificates."

echo
echo "=== SERVICE CREDENTIALS (save these) ==="
echo "Vaultwarden:  https://vault.example.com"
echo "  Admin panel: https://vault.example.com/admin"
echo "  Admin token (generated on the server): $(grep '^ADMIN_TOKEN=' /opt/vaultwarden/.env | cut -d= -f2-)"
echo "  Sign-in: open the URL and create your own account (your email + a master password you choose). The admin token above is only for the /admin panel."
echo "  Signups: open"
echo "Nextcloud:    https://files.example.com"
echo "  Administrator: admin"
echo "  Password (generated on the server): $(grep '^NEXTCLOUD_ADMIN_PASSWORD=' /opt/nextcloud/.env | cut -d= -f2-)"
echo "Jellyfin:     https://media.example.com"
echo "  IMPORTANT: open this URL right now and finish the setup wizard — until you do, whoever opens the page becomes the administrator."
echo "  Media library (mounted read-only): /srv/media"
echo "VPN Panel: https://vpn.example.com"
echo "  Admin panel: https://vpn.example.com"
echo "  Administrator: $(grep '^ADMIN_USER=' /opt/gryonix-vpn-panel/.env | cut -d= -f2-)"
echo "  Password (generated on the server): $(grep '^ADMIN_PASSWORD=' /opt/gryonix-vpn-panel/.env | cut -d= -f2-)"
